children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the area of the shaded region if $r=6$. Give the exact answer and also an approximation correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
The large radius is 2r and each small radius is r.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=\pi(2r)^2-2\pi r^2=2\pi r^2\\A&=2\pi(6)^2=72\pi\text{ cm}^2\\A&\approx226.19\text{ cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$
